queer_characters.name: Vanessa
queer_characters.notes: Described as a young Puerto Rican transgender woman navigating her transition; portrayed with 'tender performances' and played by transgender actress Harmony Santana, lending authenticity to the role.

queer_creators.name: Harmony Santana
queer_creators.notes: Source states she is herself transgender and made history as the first openly transgender actress nominated for an Independent Spirit Award for this role.
